## Notes

The record seal is intact. The audit reports no breaks, errors or blocked calls, and findings.json contains no findings. Checked all three transcript turns, tool arguments and results, backend responses, direct model calls, the copied app spec and business rules, and the app code in app.py, entry.py, services.py, stock.py and toy_model.py. Read state.json and stock.json without changing app state. No notes.jsonl or app-state files were present.

The stock replies agree with the recorded backend results and current stock.json: 3 teapot sets and 12 blue mugs. Order 6210's status and price agree with the lookup result and state.json. The earlier stock result supports the reference to 3 available teapot sets in turn 3. Offering a reservation is consistent with the user goals; the tester had not requested a reservation, so no reserve call was required.

Compared every turn with both limits. Durations were 3.376, 61.406 and 3.624 seconds against a 30-second limit. Model-session output tokens were 82, 136 and 199 against a 2000-token limit. All required limit values were known. The unknown aggregate usage includes direct model API calls, which the token limit excludes.

The expected lookup_order, check_stock, stock GET /stock and openai trace points appear for the applicable turns. No reservation was exercised. Returns, refunds, other-customer privacy and unrelated-topic handling were not exercised, so this test does not establish their correctness. The app was not started or messaged during evaluation. Only this report was written.
